modelingReview: Generated views are visual references, not a dimensional orthographic contract. Resolve differences in one Blender blockout before rigging.
Rootback charge arrow points opposite to the visible facing; use body facing and explicit world axes in the later animation contract.
Otter follow-through illustration swings upward. It is not a validated downward repair-strike animation; re-author the contact/follow-through when choosing its gameplay action.
Turret small views contain simplified supports; establish shared pivot, rail, barrel travel and projectile origin in the actual mesh.
